PRODUCT DESIGN CASE STUDY

Vista Digital Banking

MY ROLE · Corporate and retail UX/UI, design system and front-end review

Vista Digital Banking

At ITSS, I worked on Vista’s digital banking experience across four West African subsidiaries. I designed for people handling different accounts, currencies and approval responsibilities without losing track of the context.

01What I wanted to solve

A corporate customer may act for several legal entities, while a payment may need another person’s approval. I worked across onboarding, dashboards, transfers and approvals, with local language and market requirements.

02The decisions that mattered

Show which entity the customer is acting for.

I moved entity selection into the main account context instead of leaving it buried in settings.

Treat approvals as work to do.

I brought pending payment requests above the fold, with separate counts so the blocking task is visible.

Keep one product across four markets.

I built shared patterns with room for local currencies, language and regulatory copy, and reviewed front-end builds in HTML/CSS.
